note: Hand-curated from published meta snapshots for the current patch; positions are a sensible default for the board on a neutral matchup, not a rule. Board tuples are [championId, row, col, star, items]: row 0 is the frontline, col 0..6.

comps.name: Ashe Fast 9
comps.summary: The best comp of the patch even after the 18.2b nerf: a Blossom/Hunter board that levels to 9 by 5-2 and caps with Ashe and Ahri.

carries.note: Shojin or Blue Buff is mandatory; Morello and IE are fine third slots.
Nashor's, Shojin or Blue Buff as the mana item.

flex.note: Interchangeable with Gnar as the last frontliner.
Interchangeable with Taric.

extra.note: Level 10 or spare gold: Blossom Lux for the 5th/7th breakpoint.
Early Blossom body; drop for Alune at 9.

augments.note: Any econ augment first; then items over combat.
Blossom's Call makes the opener free.
Wisp Rebate turns the Blossom wisps into pure profit.

howToPlay: Open with Invoker Morgana + Ahri or any Blossom board; do not itemise Maokai early, he scales with game length.
Keep whichever streak you are on through stages 2–5; the comp wants a clean econ, not a stage-3 roll.
Level 8 at 4-2/4-5 for Ahri 2 and Sett 2, then 9 by 5-2 for Ashe and Alune.
Buy econ Wisps early and the cheap combat Wisps on rounds you must win.
comps.positioning: Ashe shoots towards the largest enemy line: put her on the opposite side to their frontline clump so the arrows cross the whole board. Ahri sits one hex in from the corner; Sett takes the side the enemy carry is on.

stages.stage2: Buy every pair; play the strongest 4–5 units at level 4 by 2-1 and level 5 at 2-5. Slam the first two components on whatever tank and carry you own; interest matters more than the exact unit. Take econ Wisps (gold, XP) unless a 0–1 gold combat Wisp saves a streak.
stages.stage3: Level 6 at 3-2 and 7 at 3-5 or 4-1 depending on HP; do not roll. Hold the streak you are on: a clean win- or loss-streak both bank gold. Keep 50 gold from 3-2 onwards and only break it to stay above 40 HP.
stages.stage4: Level 8 at 4-2 or 4-5 and roll only for the 4-cost 2★s the board needs to survive; stop at 30–40 gold. If HP is fine, keep econ and go 9 at 5-1/5-2. If HP is under 30, roll deeper now: dying with gold is the worst outcome.
stages.stage5: Level 9 by 5-2 and roll down for the 5-cost carries and the missing 2★s; from here every round of gold is board strength. Scout every fight: position the carry away from the assassin side and the tank on the side of their damage. Level 10 only when the lobby is slow and you are already stable.

If you cannot reach 9 with 30+ gold, this is an 8th: pivot to Aphelios Flex at level 8 instead.

comps.positioning: Kayle corner-back; Xayah on the other side; three 3★ tanks across the front.

stages.stage2: Buy every copy of Kayle and Xayah and the other 1-cost carries; play them 2★ on 2-1 and stay level 3–4. Slam the carry's core item first, then a tank item. Take rerolls and econ Wisps; stay above 30 gold.
stages.stage3: Dig at 3-1 for the 1-cost pairs and slow-roll from 3-2; level 6 only after the first 3★s land (better 2-cost odds). Field five different 1-costs for the Field of Mice Wisp.
stages.stage4: Level 6 at 4-1 and roll for the last 3★ and the 2-cost 2★s; all-in at 4-1 if the board is not stabilised. From 4-2 play for the 3★ frontline.
stages.stage5: Level 7 at 5-1 and 8 only late; the board caps with 3★ 1- and 2-costs plus one 5-cost. Position the carry in the second row so it engages after the tanks; scout for Zephyr and assassins.

comps.name: Lunarwood Kha'Zix
comps.summary: TFT Academy's S tier: an early Kha'Zix that evolves at 8, 30 and 60 kills with Ravager/Executioner support.

carries.note: Lich Bane artifact when offered. Rengar must stay off the board for Rival.

flex.note: Trait priority Ravager > Executioner > Rapidfire > Spellweaver (healing).

extra.note: Inferno/Executioner cap at 8.

augments.note: Items > econ > combat; trait-specific augments for the support traits.

howToPlay: Requires an early Kha'Zix (2-1 to 2-3) and lots of items; play high tempo and let him farm kills.
Never field Rengar alongside him: Rival only rewards a lone Rival.
comps.positioning: Kha'Zix front-centre so he reaches the first kill fast; Camille and Diana beside him, casters spread in the back.

stages.stage2: Needs Kha'Zix by 2-3; play him in the front with the strongest board and slam Edge of Night or an AP item on him early. Never field Rengar.
stages.stage3: Level 5 at 3-1 and roll down to 30–40 gold for the 3-cost 2★ and the frontline pairs, then stop. At 3-5 level 6 for the trait breakpoint. Buy every copy of the carry you see; slow-roll above 50 only if the board is winning.
stages.stage4: Slow-roll at 7 for Kha'Zix 3★ while he farms the 30-kill evolution; level 8 at 4-5 with the Ravager/Executioner bodies.
stages.stage5: Level 8 at 5-1 once the 3★s are done and add the 5-cost cap-out; the 3★ carry wants a frontline that lasts, so late gold goes into 2★ tanks first. Position the carry two hexes from the side with enemy assassins and scout every round.

comps.name: Tristana Rengar Reroll
comps.summary: Emblem-dependent 3-cost reroll: the Sprykin, Hunter or Fae emblem dictates the build around Rengar and Tristana.

carries.note: Titan's always; the other two depend on the emblem variant.

flex.note: Sprykin/Hunter/Fae bodies by variant.

extra.note: Fae Lux in the Fae variant.

augments.note: Emblem > items > econ.

howToPlay: Commit from an early Rengar or an emblem at 2-1; level 7 on 3-5 from a loss-streak (or 4-1 if winning), slow-roll for the 3★s.
comps.positioning: Rengar front-centre; Tristana back-corner away from the enemy assassins; Rammus on the side that takes the first engage.

stages.stage2: Only commit with the emblem or augment on 2-1; otherwise play a normal opener. Buy the carries, slam their core items, take econ Wisps.
stages.stage3: Level 6 at 3-2 and roll down to 30 gold for the 2★ carries; the emblem unit must hold its trait slot. Level 7 at 3-5 on a loss-streak or 4-1 on a win-streak.
stages.stage4: Slow-roll at 7 for the 3★s while keeping 30+ gold; go 8 at 4-5 only after the carries are 3★ or HP is under 25.
stages.stage5: Level 8/9 and add the 5-cost that shares the emblem's trait. Position the carry two hexes from assassins and the emblem holder in the second row where its trait matters, not where it dies first.
